hypotheses.estimand: Delta_T = P(NONSTRUCTURAL_SEPARATION | ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING) - P(NONSTRUCTURAL_SEPARATION | SIMULTANEOUS), standardized over the frozen supported module/universe surface
hypotheses.mechanism: When competing demands are consistently separated in time, temporal partition is an available low-dimensional routing solution; simultaneous exposure removes that temporal escape route.
support_requirements: both timing levels have >=2 dependence blocks overall
cross-universe language additionally requires the frozen common-module and per-universe outcome-support gates
falsification_or_downgrade: posterior probability mass does not support Delta_T > 0 under both registered priors
U2 and U6 universe-specific timing contrasts have opposite signs
common-support or outcome-support gate fails: pooled association may be reported but not cross-universe generality

hypotheses.estimand: Delta_M = P(STRUCTURAL_MODULE_DIVISION | MODULAR) - P(STRUCTURAL_MODULE_DIVISION | SINGLE), standardized over the supported U2 timing surface
hypotheses.mechanism: Pre-existing independently addressable conflict-bearing units lower the architectural reorganization needed to route competing functions into structural division of labour.
support_requirements: U2 retains >=2 independent blocks in SINGLE and MODULAR after adjudication
target response has adequate U2 support
module effect is not described as cross-universe replicated because U6 is pre-outcome SINGLE-only
falsification_or_downgrade: Delta_M is not positive under the registered priors
structural response lacks sufficient U2 support
module is confounded with timing within the final U2 design

secondary_non_directional_axes.rule: report descriptively/U2-specific; no directional primary hypothesis frozen
secondary support/sensitivity only because DISTRIBUTED has one pre-outcome block

reporting_rules: report both registered directional contrasts regardless of sign when estimable
do not select only the hypothesis with the stronger posterior result
do not change response grouping after seeing results
cross-universe generality is a stronger claim than a pooled positive Delta_T
null or reversed contrasts remain reportable results under the frozen design
